text_block_list.text:
Since Agnes Digital wasn't feeling well,
we decided to go pray at the shrine together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mumble, mumble... grumble, grumble...!

I heard a fervent prayer. Could they really be
worrying that intensely...? Or so I thought...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
May happiness find every Umamusume...
May blessings be upon every Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Please, let this prayer reach them...!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't mind about yourself...?
Are you sure you don't mind about yourself...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Force of habit...!
This isn't the household altar in my room...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Out of habit, I ended up praying for my fave's happiness...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We came here today to fix your slump, right?
Let's pull ourselves together and try one more time...
choice_data_list: No, honest feelings are what matter most.
No, honest feelings are what matter most, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
Y-You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Besides, "an Umamusume's happiness"
= "my happiness"!
So it's totally for my own good too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Gfufu!
I'm waiting on full standby for those divine blessings~~!!"
Huh? Haaay, Digital-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nwah! Th-This voice is...!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, what a coincidence!
Are you visiting the shrine with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Yes, ma'am!
Are you here to visit the shrine too, Falco-san...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ I came to make a wish to God.
"May I get to interact even more with all my fans as an Umadol"...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It came true right away~☆
Falco is so, so happy~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guuugh!! That smile is so blindinggg...! N-No, I'm the one who's happyyy!
choice_data_list: I'm glad it worked out for you two.
I'm glad it worked out for you two, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeeshh!! Thank goodness, thank goodness...!
So precious, so cute, so blissful... lost for words...

It seemed to have worked its magic right away.
Agnes Digital completely recovered
her peak condition.
(Ding-dong)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hm? An email...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wha, wha-wha-what...!
'Notice of Performance Postponement'... !?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh! You've gotta be kidding! No way!?
I was looking forward to the concert so muchhh~~!!

Agnes Digital was terribly crestfallen.
Her condition remained poor even after that...
